beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Spring entrance — clean, settles into position. Overshoot spring — high stiffness, the mark slams in, squashes, rebounds; it's overconfident and that's useful. Draw-on stroke in terracotta, then the fill. Mask reveal with a clip-path wipe then an iris. Four arrivals, four personalities.

Your turn. Paste this: animate my logo's entrance with a spring, then a mask wipe — and tell me which one feels like a reveal and which one feels like a pop. A reveal implies something was hidden. A pop implies it just decided to exist.
Bear Brown logo, in motion. Part one. Liam, in for Bear.
